title: Payment Card Entry Fix

sections.name: Automatic checkout
items: Credit/Debit Card is now selected once, allowing Pokémon Center's card form to finish rendering before Brava fills it.
Card number and CVV are typed into their inputs after the payment form appears.
Expiration month and year are selected from Pokémon Center's separate dropdowns, including two-digit year values.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
